answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each participant to post a bonded stake tied to a verifiable identity anchor, making the marginal cost of a fake persona exceed its expected yield at the network's zenith of activity. Audit trails record every stake and transfer in a crystal clear ledger, so colluding clusters on any island of the topology are detected when their. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
